name: session-notes
description: Keeps the notes Claude writes for each session, what is left to do first, then what was done, in the plugin store, never in Claude's context or session data; Claude writes notes with write_note or /note, amends them with amend_note and deletes them with delete_note; the session-notes shell command lists, amends and deletes notes outside Claude Code, with zsh tab completion; /notes shows them in a pane
